description: Voice quality canon for character voice acting and TTS outputs.

quality_dimensions.name: Voice Fit
quality_dimensions.description: Voice must match character profile and casting contract.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Voice gender, age, tone, and accent match casting contract.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Voice does not match character description or was rejected by operator.

quality_dimensions.name: Pacing
quality_dimensions.description: Delivery speed must match scene timing and emotional intent.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Pacing appropriate for scene emotion. Not rushed or unnaturally slow.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Pacing breaks scene rhythm or emotional delivery.

quality_dimensions.name: Pronunciation Clarity
quality_dimensions.description: Words must be intelligible and correctly pronounced.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: All words intelligible at normal playback. Proper names correct.

quality_dimensions.name: Emotional Delivery
quality_dimensions.description: Voice must convey the intended emotion of the scene.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Flat, inappropriate, or contradictory emotional tone.
